import socket,time,json
result={'endpoint':'127.0.0.1:7500','operation':'receive_only','sent_bytes':0,'limit_seconds':3,'byte_limit':4096}
start=time.monotonic()
try:
 with socket.create_connection(('127.0.0.1',7500),3) as s:
  result['connected']=True
  s.settimeout(max(0.001,3-(time.monotonic()-start)))
  try:
   data=s.recv(4096)
   result.update(received_bytes=len(data),payload_hex=data.hex(),termination='eof' if not data else 'one_receive')
  except TimeoutError:
   result.update(received_bytes=0,termination='receive_deadline')
except OSError as error:
 result.update(connected=False,error_type=type(error).__name__,error=str(error))
result['elapsed_seconds']=time.monotonic()-start
print(json.dumps(result,indent=2))
raise SystemExit(0 if result.get('connected') else 1)
